meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查本地安装的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 是否健康，并与最新源码对比，生成一份 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，每条结论都附有证据。
howto.when: 当你提到“医生”、“健康检查”、“LazyCodex”、“lazycodex-ai”、“omo-codex”等关键词，或感觉 Codex 安装后、更新后、配置变更后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 安装是否健康。
say.note: Claude 会运行诊断并生成报告。

say.text: 我的 Codex 最近更新后有点奇怪，帮我看看。
say.note: Claude 会对比最新源码，找出差异。

say.text: 检查本地 LazyCodex 和 Codex 版本是否最新。
say.note: Claude 会对比最新发布版本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude inspects the local LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health, compares it against the latest sources, and produces a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence for each verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "doctor", "health check", "LazyCodex", "lazycodex-ai", "omo-codex", or when Codex behaves oddly after install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex installation is healthy.
say_en.note: Claude runs diagnostics and generates a report.

say_en.text: My Codex has been acting weird after the latest update, please check.
say_en.note: Claude compares against latest sources to find drift.

say_en.text: Check if my local LazyCodex and Codex versions are up to date.
